canada.title: B.C. teen who moved schools for volleyball denied competitive play by transfer bylaw
canada.summary: A 16-year-old B.C. teen who moved from Hudson's Hope to Fort St. John to attend a school with a senior girls volleyball team won't be allowed to play this year because of a longstanding bylaw on athlete transfers.

canada.title: Family of injured Wainwright soldier holds bedside vigil in burn unit
canada.summary: Pte. Liam Ramage, 27, of Red Deer, Alta., was one of dozens of service members hurt in an out-of-control grass fire at CFB Wainwright on Oct. 17.

canada.title: Parents say new Harbour Landing school in Regina long overdue
canada.summary: The province announced the new joint-use school is 70 per cent complete and set to open next September.

canada.title: Committee backs bigger, YMCA-run pool on Saskatoon's east side
canada.summary: City administration had recommended moving ahead with a less ambitious hybrid model featuring a six-lane pool with a 4,000-square-foot fitness area, run by the YMCA as a city facility. But Coun. Zach Jeffries, whose ward is located on the east side of the city and who has long advocated for the new facility, proposed a bigger option.

canada.title: How the U.S. midterm election results could affect Canada
canada.summary: Control of both chambers of the U.S. Congress will shift to the Democrats next year, after Tuesday’s midterm elections saw a blue wave wash over even some of the most reliably Republican states.

canada.title: Woman dead after being struck by vehicle in Newmarket, police say
canada.summary: A woman in her 20s has died after being struck by a vehicle in Newmarket, Ont., on Wednesday evening, police say.

canada.title: Man whose arm was broken in arrest attempt says he's scared to go to court after RCMP officer charged
canada.summary: A Thompson man says he's still suffering lasting effects after his arm was broken last year during an attempted arrest by an off-duty Manitoba RCMP officer, who has now been criminally charged.

canada.title: Manitoba developing strategy to help first responders overwhelmed by drug calls
canada.summary: First responders struggling to cope with a surge in drug use and overdoses will be getting new supports from the Manitoba government.

canada.title: 75% of Parks Canada employees in N.B. told their jobs could be at risk
canada.summary: The possibility of job losses for some Parks Canada staff could hit New Brunswick especially hard, with three-quarters of the department's employees in the province at risk.

canada.title: ‘Everybody’s pissed’: Sand blowing into homes next to rural N.S. subdivision development
canada.summary: Residents say they're fed up with blowing sand from the site of a subdivision development in the middle of a quiet neighbourhood in Coldbrook, N.S.

canada.title: N.S. health minister 'guardedly optimistic' about funding talks with Ottawa
canada.summary: Nova Scotia’s health minister says she’s “guardedly optimistic” that a longer-term arrangement can be reached in the wake of a recent one-year extension of targeted federal funding.

canada.title: Young Inuk cook making her name known among Ottawa's best
canada.summary: A young Inuk caterer is making a name for herself as one of the best cooks in Ottawa's crowded culinary scene. In October, Sierra Conboy took home the people's choice award for best dish at this year's Ottawa Citizen Best Restaurants event.

canada.title: Bay Roberts auto shops fed up with string of wheel thefts
canada.summary: Theft has been on wheels as of late, according to two automotive shops in Bay Roberts. Last Friday night, one business owner caught someone in the act.

canada.title: St. John’s library location search could be hampered by government criteria: MHA
canada.summary: For months, the people in the west end of St. John’s have been without a new library after the Michael Donovan Library closed its doors. As the provincial government is still looking for a new landlord to house the library, MHA Keith West is hoping the process will speed up.

canada.title: From job cuts to AI, public service unions are closely watching today's budget
canada.summary: With concerns around job cuts, return-to-work mandates, artificial intelligence and more, Canada's largest public service unions will be following Thursday's federal budget closely to see if the Carney government has paid heed to their recommendations.

canada.title: Shingles cases are declining in Quebec among most age groups — except millennials
canada.summary: While Quebec health officials say cases of shingles are dropping among most age groups, people between 25 and 49 are not seeing a decline.

canada.title: Fewer Montrealers are placing bets, but online gambling has tripled: new study
canada.summary: Fewer Montrealers are gambling than they were seven to eight years ago. But online gambling is moving in the opposite direction — nearly tripling since 2018. And public health researchers say that shift comes with risks.
